geometry.geometry_revision: user supplied input.json; original 28 vertices, 48 triangular panels, 2 quadrilateral roofs, 76 edges

frames.fea_frame: Right-handed; bottom roof center at (0,0,0), upper roof center at (0,0,0.0264); +Z points toward upper roof
frames.isaac_frame: Right-handed Z-up; knee bottom roof center at world (0,0,0.1186)

source_to_fea.equation: p_fea = scale * R * p_source + translation; no reflection

frames.zero_definition: Original folded JSON shape is assumed stress free at zero cable tensions
frames.positive_angle_direction: Right-hand rotation-vector components of the bottom cap relative to fixed upper cap. Pattern names identify cable families, not Euler-angle signs.
frames.compression_sign: Positive bottom cap Z translation shortens cap separation.

material.model: Provisional isotropic linear elasticity; perfect PLA/PET bond; no measured stock-grade identification
material.gap_selection: Owner requested least practical exposure. 0.1/0.2/0.4 mm numerical candidates only; manufacturing minimum and optimum NOT established.

mesh.element_type: Quadratic TET10, four-point Gauss integration, physical PET and PLA thickness
mesh.characteristic_length_note: Highly nonuniform layered mesh; physical film thickness 80e-6 m, exposed gap 200e-6 m. No single representative element length.
mesh.convergence_summary: Refinement 2 to 3 at 0.1 N/active cable changes shortening by 24.6%, bend-X angle by 22.0%, CW twist by 21.6% (relative to refinement 2). Peak stress also changes. Not converged.

boundary_conditions: All upper roof PET clamp DOFs fixed
Lower roof PET clamp nodes constrained by six rigid-body coordinates using exact rotations
Both original roof quads remain rigid; roof flexure excluded
Interior FEM DOFs statically condensed exactly from assembled linear stiffness
Rigid unloaded upper/lower leg links and foot follow cap transforms; no other origami joint

loads.layout: Four same-corner axial, four CW cross-plate, four reverse cross-plate; corners ordered (-x,-y),(+x,-y),(+x,+y),(-x,+y)

solver.software: Custom NumPy/SciPy finite-element solver in Isaac Sim Kit Python; not native PhysX deformable dynamics
solver.analysis_type: Quasistatic small-strain linear-elastic continuum with exact rigid-cap rotations and cable-length energy
solver.notes: Guards are scope limits, not material allowables. At rejected load, retain last valid geometry.

limitations: NOT validated large folding, buckling, crease rest angles or hysteresis
No gravity, payload transmission, foot contact, inertia, balance or walking
No plasticity, damage, bond failure or fatigue
No cable slack dynamics, stretch, friction, guides, spools or crossing contact; expanded routing is provisional
No deformation amplification; true-scale movements are small
No native PhysX force integration or calibrated reduced-order model; ML baseline unchanged and no training

review.notes: Source identity and implementation verified. Physical validation and owner review still required. Larger video motions are observational references, not force/displacement calibration.
